title: gradient.c:306 sf_select reads stale data from expired entries
description: lichen_gradient_sf_select() does not check entry expiry, unlike lichen_gradient_sf_update() which uses lichen_gradient_lookup(). This allows sf_select to read stale SNR/SF data from an expired entry and modify entry->sf.current_sf on it. When a fresh routing update arrives, lichen_gradient_update() preserves the SF state (lines 165-175), persisting SF decisions made from stale data. The function should use lichen_gradient_lookup() or check expiry manually and return -ENOENT for expired entries.
